title: When the Songbook Falls
author: O. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Sterling, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
